newsitem.title: USA: Air France exports at JFK up 13.5 pct in.
newsitem.headline: Air France exports at JFK up 13.5 pct in.

text.p: Air France handled 1,743 tonnes of outbound commercial freight at New York's John F. Kennedy Airport in July, up 13.5 percent from 1,535 tonnes handled in July 1996,Air France's U.S. media relations manager, Michael Carroll, told Reuters.
Inbound volume showed a decline last month at 2,126 tonnes down 5.7 percent from 2,255 tonnes in July 1996.
Carroll attributed the increased outbound volume to a "change in cargo and passenger capacity on some flights."

The carrier operates two weekly round-trip Boeing 747-200F between JFK and Paris, six weekly round trip 747-Combi's and a daily round-trip Concorde service. The frequency of flights was the same one year ago, Carroll said.

General consolidated freight headed both its outbound and inbound list of commodities handled in July. Outbound from JFK, this category is followed by medical equipment and machinery while inbound, apparel and cosmetics followed. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
